evidence: A first draft by the rules of districts.md on the design surface, design climate and design routing: computed units and facts with short computed descriptions; their significance awaits written judgment and the author's review. Codes stand in for names.
reading_rule: Areas in km2, heights in metres above the common level; at.today and at.turned are each unit's label point (latitude, longitude east). coasts lists the coastal sea districts a land district faces or feeds; faces and fed_by list the land districts a coastal sea faces and those whose rivers reach it with at least 5% of their area.

terlunan.label: Terlunan
terlunan.roots: the author's conlang v0.6 (Tahitian, Māori, Hawaiian, Hakka, Sumerian, Akkadian)
terlunan.order: modifier-head, fused, as Terlunan compounds (dungu + tap = dungutap)
terlunan.where: shores and islands, and the seas

olivolingvo.label: Proto-Olivolingvo
olivolingvo.roots: the author's Esperanto-based tongue with Hebrew loans (h' the, -im plural)
olivolingvo.order: h' + noun + adjective, as in the author's poem (h'naharo keraha, the frozen river)
olivolingvo.where: the polar lands and the semi-arid uplands

sahran.label: Sahran (Arabic- and Amazigh-rooted)
sahran.roots: Arabic and Tamazight landscape words, simplified sounds
sahran.order: head + modifier, as Arabic names run (Wadi Nur); Tamazight heads where they fit (Adrar, Asif, Tala)

tagalhebrew.label: Tagalog-Hebrew
tagalhebrew.roots: Tagalog heads and Hebrew modifiers, the author's hybrid idea
tagalhebrew.order: Tagalog head, the linker -ng after a vowel or na after a consonant, Hebrew modifier (Lawang Or)

pwani.label: Pwani (Swahili-rooted)
pwani.roots: Swahili landscape words, without the noun-class agreement

dala.label: Dala (Turkic- and Mongolic-rooted)
dala.roots: Kazakh, Kyrgyz and Mongolian landscape words

runa.label: Runa (Quechua-rooted)
runa.roots: Quechua landscape words, spelled without ejective marks
runa.where: the high mountains and their cloud forests

satoyama.label: Satogo (Japanese-rooted)
satoyama.roots: Japanese landscape words, with sequential voicing in compounds
satoyama.order: modifier + head, fused, the head voiced (Kurogawa, black river)

terlunan_coined.loko: lake (Hawaiian loko; roto is taken by inside)
